title: Kimi K3 Is Now Available in Cosmic
summary: Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI is now live in Cosmic. Select it in the dashboard model dropdown or call it via the AI text generation API and SDK. Available today.
body_markdown:
Kimi K3 is now available in Cosmic, both in the dashboard and via the API. Select it from the model dropdown in your Agent or AI settings, or pass` kimi-k3` as the model parameter in any AI text generation call.


## What Is Kimi K3?


[Kimi K3](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-quickstart) is Moonshot AI's latest open-source frontier model, designed for complex reasoning, coding, and long-context tasks. It joins Cosmic's growing roster of supported models alongside Claude, Gemini, and GPT, giving your team more flexibility to route tasks to the right model for the job.


## Use It in the Dashboard


Head to your Agent or AI settings inside the Cosmic dashboard and select *Kimi K3* from the model dropdown. No configuration, no API calls required. Pick it and start generating.


## Use It via the API and SDK


Cosmic's AI text generation endpoint accepts a` model` parameter. Pass` kimi-k3` to route your request through Kimi K3. A bucket write key is required for all AI operations.


### JavaScript SDK


```text
import     {   createBucketClient   }     from     '@cosmicjs/sdk'


const   cosmic   =     createBucketClient  (  {
bucketSlug  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_SLUG'  ,
readKey  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_READ_KEY'  ,
writeKey  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_WRITE_KEY'
}  )


// Generate text with Kimi K3
const   response   =     await   cosmic  .  ai  .  generateText  (  {
model  :     'kimi-k3'  ,
prompt  :     'Write a product description for a noise-canceling headset'  ,
max_tokens  :     500
}  )


console  .  log  (  response  .  text  )
console  .  log  (  response  .  usage  )     // { input_tokens, output_tokens }
```


### REST API


```text
curl   https://workers.cosmicjs.com/v3/buckets/  ${BUCKET_SLUG}  /ai/text   \
-H   'Content-Type: application/json'     \
-H   "Authorization: Bearer   ${BUCKET_WRITE_KEY}  "     \
-d   '{"model":"kimi-k3","prompt":"Write a product description for a noise-canceling headset","max_tokens":500}'
```


### Streaming


Kimi K3 supports real-time streaming via the` stream: true` parameter:


```text
import     {   createBucketClient  ,     TextStreamingResponse     }     from     '@cosmicjs/sdk'


const   cosmic   =     createBucketClient  (  {
bucketSlug  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_SLUG'  ,
readKey  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_READ_KEY'  ,
writeKey  :     'YOUR_BUCKET_WRITE_KEY'
}  )


const   result   =     await   cosmic  .  ai  .  generateText  (  {
model  :     'kimi-k3'  ,
prompt  :     'Explain headless CMS architecture in plain English'  ,
max_tokens  :     800  ,
stream  :     true
}  )


const   stream   =   result   as     TextStreamingResponse


stream  .  on  (  'text'  ,     (  text  )     =>   process  .  stdout  .  write  (  text  )  )
stream  .  on  (  'usage'  ,     (  usage  )     =>     console  .  log  (  'Usage:'  ,   usage  )  )
stream  .  on  (  'end'  ,     (  )     =>     console  .  log  (  '\nDone.'  )  )
```


## Why Model Choice Matters


Different tasks call for different models. You might route long-form reasoning to Kimi K3, rapid generation to a fast Gemini Flash model, and complex editorial work to Claude Opus. Cosmic's model-agnostic API means you can route each task to the best available model without changing your content infrastructure.


The content stays in Cosmic. The model is a parameter.
